summary: Resume suspended OMP seats with matching authored transcript selectors

compatibility.detail: Strict OMP resume accepts an authored absolute transcript selector when its filename and header identify the recorded native session, including when a pinned resume path is present. Both paths must identify the recorded session; mismatches remain refused. agents start refuses held suspended seats with start-suspended and directs callers to agents resume instead of successfully publishing a declaration that cannot start.

manual.detail: Use agents resume for an existing suspended seat; agents start does not lift a suspension.

recovery.detail: No migration or state rewrite is required.
